title: bounded provisioned-throughput replay template
label: UNVERIFIED ILLUSTRATIVE TEMPLATE for a model and region separately confirmed as provisioned-throughput eligible. Every workload, target, arrival-rate, burst, worker, pending, CPT, calibration, and output-cap value must be reviewed. This file has client bounds but no rate_limits object or built-in provider-capacity guard; enforce the applicable provisioned capacity and account limits externally. Replace the bundled profile and targets with measured workload and customer-owned requirements. Size mean occupancy from measured mean service time; tail latency is headroom evidence, not Little's Law. Shard only after one generator is proven insufficient.
